title: PARO: Hardware-Software Co-design with Pattern-aware Reorder-based Attention Quantization in Video Generation Models
problem: 3D full attention in video generation models creates massive attention maps (56.50 GB for CogVideoX-5B) consuming excessive computation time (1 min per 49-frame video on A100).
motivation: Video generation with transformers dominates inference cost; attention quantization requires careful pattern handling to preserve quality.
method: PARO investigates diverse 3D full attention patterns and proposes reorder technique unifying them into block-diagonal structure. Block-wise mixed-precision quantization achieves lossless compression at 4.80-bit average. Output-bitwidth aware PE array co-design optimizes mixed-precision QK multiplication.
key_novelty: Pattern-aware reorder technique unifying diverse attention patterns into block-diagonal structure enabling efficient mixed-precision quantization.
contributions: Analysis of diverse 3D full attention patterns in video generation
Reorder technique unifying patterns into block-diagonal structure
Block-wise mixed-precision quantization at 4.80-bit average for lossless compression
Output-bitwidth aware PE array enabling full mixed-precision utilization
2.71x speedup vs NVIDIA A100, 6.38-7.05x over SOTA ASIC accelerators
limitations: Evaluation limited to CogVideoX-2B/5B; generalization to other video models not discussed.
primary_theme: Pattern-aware attention quantization for efficient video generation acceleration
